text:
cs-alert-bot: ALERT: GreenGrain Logistics (acct gg_309) onboarding health dropped to 58%. Activation events missed: template_setup, webhook_confirm. Renewal in 18 days. Auto-tagged: "onboarding-risk".

Lina Morales: Noted. They've been in onboarding for 9 weeks with low activity past 2 wks. Original plan was 4 wks. Renewal 05/09.

Roberto Vega: They told AE that finance pushed go-live to next quarter unless we can prove ROI faster.

Jillian Park: Root signals: setup funnel shows 3/4 steps completed but templates and webhook test never ran. No errors; just stuck at manual config step.

Omar Patel: I took a quick look at their tenant: webhook endpoint returns 200 but payload shape mismatches our sample (missing invoice_line.items). That explains the team pausing.

Lina Morales: Ok key risks = (1) perceived integration work, (2) no early wins to show stakeholders, (3) renewal approaching.

Roberto Vega: Suggest a quick "engineer-assisted setup" plus a 2-week feature trial on our premium routing (to show latency and cost savings) and a custom ROI snapshot for their 5 biggest customers.

Jillian Park: Love that. Proposed save plan: 1) schedule 60m enablement + remote pairing to finish templates/webhook; 2) run two demo invoices through their prod-like data with SE; 3) issue a 2-week extended trial on premium routes + one-off onboarding credit; 4) set milestone emails and CSM check-ins (day 3, 7, 14).

Omar Patel: I can pair and fix the payload mapping. Need their sample payload and a time window.

Lina Morales: Reaching out to their technical lead now. Draft message: "We can jump on a 60-minute pairing session to finish webhook mapping and run two real invoices end-to-end. We'll also enable a 14-day premium trial so you can validate performance and cost. When are you free?" Thoughts?

Roberto Vega: Short and clear. Offer two slots tomorrow 10am PT or 3pm PT.

cs-alert-bot: NOTE: ticket #CS-4998 created and linked to gg_309.

Jillian Park: I'll create a short enablement checklist and a one-pager ROI template we can fill during the call. Will add links to config snippets and the webhook mapping example.

Omar Patel: Adding a quick mapping snippet here to share with them beforehand:\n```\n# example transform (python)\ndef transform(payload):\n    return {\n        \"items\": [i[\"description\"] for i in payload.get(\"invoice_line\", [])],\n        \"total\": payload.get(\"amount_total\")\n    }\n```\n
Lina Morales: They replied: "Thanks — 10am PT works, thanks for the assist." Booked.

Roberto Vega: I'll offer a one-month renewal credit prorated if they hit the milestone in 14 days (makes finance happy to defer churn).

Jillian Park: Setting milestones in Gainsight: Day3=webhook validated, Day7=2 invoices processed end-to-end, Day14=stakeholder demo scheduled. I'll add tasks and assign to Lina + Omar.

Lina Morales: After call, we'll capture logs and short screencast for execs. Also propose a short NPS pulse after milestone 2.

Omar Patel: Pairing session complete. Webhook mapping fixed, two invoices processed. Left a quick script in ticket for automating mapping.

cs-alert-bot: TICKET UPDATE: CS-4998 now has attachment "invoice-demo-screencast.mp4" and note from Omar.

Lina Morales: Customer response: "Wow that was fast, we can present this Friday to our CFO." Moving renewal risk -> "nurture" and setting follow-ups.

Jillian Park: I'll log the enablement notes in the onboarding playbook and tag this as a replayable mini-play.

Roberto Vega: Great work. I'll update renewal owners and propose the prorated credit in the renewal doc.

Lina Morales: Closing immediate loop: monitoring adoption for 14 days and will report back in renewal prep thread. Thanks team :heart:
